newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond futures, PIBOR end slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: French bond futures, PIBOR end slightly higher.

text.p: 1455 GMT - June bond future fails to hold gains above 130.40 after U.S. retail sales and settles marginally higher. Await CSA opinion poll due 1700 GMT but little reaction expected unless sharp swing to left as belief in centre-right victory growing. Franc also benefitting, at strongest vs mark since April 18. *Jun 10-yr future 130.38, up 0.08. Vol 131,164. Open 130.26 *5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.57 pct vs 5.59. Bund spread -14 vs -11 *Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Jun PIBOR 96.51, up 1 bp
